integrity: Exact-rational checker confirms finite instances only; universal formulas are proven analytically. No numerical experiment is treated as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Symmetric expansion/inverse-branch base only, uniform inverse-branch distribution, annealed Lebesgue-stationary leading-digit observables. No quenched theorem, CLT, uniqueness of stationary law, or unequal-base extension is proved. Historical-priority uncertainty remains.
title: Catalan digit-memory law at the neutral threshold of random affine interval maps
